beats.title: Sonic arrives at school the next morning

beats.text: Why hello Sonic
YOU!
*grabs him* WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?! YOU BETTER NOT BE HERE TO HARM AMY AGAIN OR I SWEAR I'LL-
Put him down Sonic
DON'T YOU KNOW WHAT HE'S DONE?! HE SHOULD BE ARRESTED FOR AMY'S SAKE!
He only got a criminal record, now put him DOWN!
You hear the boss, Sonic, so put me down or it's bye bye championship
I SWEAR I'LL F**KING STRANGLE YO-
SONIC!
So, Scourge will be facing you in the Championship league. That's why he's here. To discuss it with me
Why can't it be someone else?!
What's wrong, pal? Too scared to play against me?
I ain't your 'pal pal' and why would I be scared? You're the one who ran away from the a fight
Say's the guy who ran away to leave his friends to d-
Hi Soni-
Wow, I guess they made it out in time
IT'S SCOURGE!! *takes out hammer*
AMY!
HE ALMOST GOT ME KILLED!
Amy.. *talks quietly* If we harm him I'll get kicked out the team, I'm against his team...
*sigh* I'm sorry, Sonic...
I just don't want him to hurt you again
Don't worry, Ames... I'm gonna be just fine... as long as you're safe, that's all I need
SAVE THE HUGS AND KISSES FOR LATER! WE HAVE A GAME TO TALK ABOUT!
*ignores Scourge* Listen, I really gotta tell you something important
Just tell me already
This isn't the right time...
but Sonic-
Go to class, I don't want you late
I love you
I love you too! *walks away*
Now *turns back to Scourge* You were saying?
( I don't understand how they're alive )
